title: CIA visits Nolan's Stanford office to recruit him

tellings.quote: From my point of view, when I got involved, the CIA came to my office.

plain: Garry Nolan, a scientist at Stanford University in California, told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2021 that when he first got involved in studying UFO questions, sometime in the 2010s, the CIA, the US foreign spy agency, came to his office. He links his involvement to a circle of people already working on the topic, among them Jacques Vallee, Hal Puthoff, Eric Davis, Robert Bigelow and Kit Green. If true, it would mean the intelligence world was actively bringing in top scientists to study the subject.
